description: This file declares the Response class in the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, which inherits from a base Message class and provides methods to access JSON-RPC response details such as ID, result, error, and validity.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class representing a JSON-RPC Response message, capable of retrieving response ID, result, error, and validity status.

methods.name: ~Response
methods.description: Default destructor for the Response class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID associated with the response.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a successful result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Extracts the result object from the response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Extracts the error object from the response.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Determines if the response is valid.
